**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

- The Agreement's only competing-product exclusivity covenant, Section 3.19, binds **SFJ** and its Affiliates during the "Exclusive Period" — a restriction on the counterparty that benefits us, so it is not flagged.
- No covenant anywhere restricts PB from developing, manufacturing, marketing or selling competing products, and there is no field-of-use or territory restriction on PB. Section 15 also reserves to PB all rights not expressly granted to SFJ.
- The PB-facing restrictions in Article 7 (Sections 7.5.1–7.5.7) are financing/negative-pledge and licensing-consent covenants, not non-competes. The Section 7.5.5 consent gate on non-Excluded Licensing Transactions is noted for the negative-covenant rules rather than double-flagged here.

This satisfies the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer).
